_note: The prompt library catalog bundled into Hermes builds, pinned to a release tag of hermes-hq/hodios-dist. scripts/fetch-prompt-library.mjs downloads it, checks the manifest against manifest_sha256 and every object against its own sha256, and writes src-tauri/library/. The app checks the same manifest hash before it imports the bundled copy. Bump only with `npm run library:bump -- <tag>`.
_max_archive_bytes_note: Raised 6000000 -> 16000000 for catalog 2026.1014.1 (10,241 entries with the everyday layer: front doors, essentials, depth, intents, routing). The zstd archive grows from 5.2 MB (2026.1004.2, 3,634 entries) to about 14 MB; it is already compressed, so each installer grows by about the same 9 MB (installers are about 100 MB). Bundling it all keeps the first-run Library complete and offline: the Essentials, everyday routing and every entry's body without a download. The archive is read only when the Library first opens, never at startup.
